title: Jessica Simpson Updates Her Fashion Line for Fall as She Returns to Music & Preps New Documentary
summary: A lineup of sweater tops, faux fur & denim builds on Simpson’s fashion legacy at Walmart as she steps back into music after a 15-year hiatus.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

There’s no shortage of ’70s inspiration in Jessica Simpson’s Walmart fashion line this fall. As summer comes to a close, the collection is making room for sweater tops, denim, faux-fur pieces and other seasonal staples, with prices starting at just $8.

Simpson launched the Walmart line in 2024, adding an affordable option to the fashion empire she has built over the years. Her latest fall pieces feel like an easy way to ease into the new season without buying an entirely new wardrobe. A sweater can be layered over a summer dress, denim works with practically everything and faux fur can instantly make an outfit feel more fall-ready.

The retro influence is also easy to wear. You don’t have to commit to a full ’70s look to get in on the trend. Instead, a few throwback details can give an otherwise simple outfit a little more personality.

BEST FOR TRANSITIONAL WEATHER

Jessica Simpson Philomenia Knit Denim Pullover Top

$8.25

Buy Now at walmart

A best-seller top only available in very limited sizes.

Made with a soft knit-denim fabric, this pullover offers a more comfortable alternative to a traditional denim top. The relaxed silhouette is finished with drop shoulders, ribbed cuffs and side slits, making it easy to pair with jeans, leggings or trousers.

BEST COMFORTABLE FIT

Jessica Simpson Freesia Wide Leg Jeans

$32.50

Available in regular and long denim lengths.

From a fitted tee to a flowy blouse, these high-rise wide-leg jeans can work with just about anything already in your closet. Stretch denim keeps them comfortable, while the contrast side panels and unfinished hem give the classic five-pocket style a trendier finish.

BEST FOR FALL LAYERING

Jessica Simpson Patchwork Faux Fur Vest

$44.99

Featuring a cropped fit and easy to layer with other fall staples.

With its patchwork design, this vest taps into the retro aesthetic that continues to show up in fall fashion. Style it with denim and boots for a ’70s-inspired outfit or keep it simple with a tee and sneakers.

BEST CAPSULE WARDROBE TEE

Jessica Simpson Eydie Tee

$12 $27.50 56% off

A best-selling tee that comes in five colorways.

The Eydie has the kind of simple silhouette that lets the rest of your outfit take center stage, with cap sleeves, a crew neck and a fitted shape. Available in plus sizes ranging from 2X to 4X, style it with denim, boots and a statement layer for an easy outfit that feels ready for a night of live music.

BEST FALL ACCESSORY

Jessica Simpson Daphne Faux Leather Hobo Handbag

$38

Buy Now on walmart

Choose from three fall colorways.

If you’re tired of reaching for the same black handbag, the Daphne Hobo is an easy switch-up. The $38 style comes in a rich Pinot Noir shade with a studded strap, detachable charms and a roomy interior.

BEST FALL KNIT

Jessica Simpson Luanne Polo Sweater with Long Sleeves

$27.96

A long sleeve fall essential made from 80% cotton and 20% viscose.

The Luanne Polo Sweater is the kind of top that can easily work its way into your weekly rotation. Jessica Simpson’s lightweight design features a classic polo collar, partial button placket and scalloped trim, plus a soft ribbed texture.

BEST BUDGET-FRIENDLY ACCESSORY

Jessica Simpson Daphne Zip Around Wallet

$18

A suede-like accessory made for fall and everything you need to carry.

If your wallet is usually overflowing with cards, receipts and everything else, the Daphne Wallet gives you plenty of places to put it all. The faux-leather design features multiple card slots, a bill compartment and a zippered coin pocket, all finished with gold-tone hardware.

BEST CARDIGAN UNDER $30

Jessica Simpson Jennifer Sweater Cardigan

$28.50

Featuring a scallop hem edge detailing and available in sizes XS to XL.

A good cardigan can make getting dressed a lot easier, and this one is an easy addition to your fall rotation. The soft knit has a classic button-front design that works just as well over a T-shirt as it does with a blouse or tank.

The collection arrives as Simpson is getting ready to tell more of her story. Netflix recently acquired a feature-length documentary about the singer, entrepreneur and author, with Joe Pearlman, who directed Robbie Williams and Lewis Capaldi: How I’m Feeling Now , behind the camera. The film will explore Simpson’s career and personal journey.

Of course, music is where Simpson first made her mark. She broke onto the scene in the late 1990s alongside Britney Spears, Christina Aguilera and Mandy Moore, scoring her biggest Billboard Hot 100 hit with “I Wanna Love You Forever.” The 1999 single peaked at No. 3 on the chart.

Simpson went on to sell more than 20 million records globally before expanding into television, fashion and publishing. Following a 15-year hiatus from releasing original music, she returned with Nashville Canyon: Part 1 and Nashville Canyon: Part 2 . Now, as she continues her musical comeback, her Walmart collection is giving fans another reason to keep Jessica Simpson on their fall radar.
